description: A bibliographic element set maintained by the Library of Congress that may be used for a variety of purposes, including original resource description and as a simplified version of MARC 21 records. It is richer than Dublin Core, includes a subset of MARC fields, and uses language-based tags rather than numeric codes.

entities.name: MODS Collection
entities.description: A wrapper element for grouping multiple MODS records together. Used when a single XML document contains metadata for more than one resource.
entities.note: Optional wrapper. Each child MODS element represents a separate bibliographic record.

entities.name: MODS
entities.description: Root element for a single MODS metadata record. Contains all top-level descriptive elements for a bibliographic resource. The version attribute indicates the MODS schema version used.
entities.note: All top-level elements are optional and repeatable. Best practice recommends at least one titleInfo with a title sub-element.

entities.name: Title Info
entities.description: A word, phrase, character, or group of characters that constitutes the title of the resource. Includes subtitles and part designations. The type attribute distinguishes alternative, abbreviated, translated, and uniform titles.
entities.note: Repeatable. Best practice: include at least one titleInfo with a title sub-element. Use type attribute to distinguish title variants.

entities.name: Title
entities.description: A word, phrase, character, or group of characters that constitutes the chief title of the resource. This is the primary content of the titleInfo element.

entities.name: Subtitle
entities.description: The remainder of the title information following the main title. Typically separated by a colon or other punctuation.

entities.name: Part Number
entities.description: A part or section number of a title. Used for multipart resources to identify the numeric designation of a part.

entities.name: Part Name
entities.description: A part or section name of a title. Used for multipart resources to identify a named part or section.

entities.name: Non Sort
entities.description: Characters, including initial articles, that appear at the beginning of a title and should be ignored for indexing and sorting purposes. Introduced in MODS to handle non-filing characters.
entities.note: Common values include initial articles such as 'The ', 'A ', 'An ', 'Le ', 'La ', 'Les '. Include trailing space if needed.

entities.name: Name
entities.description: The name of a person, organization, family, or event (conference, meeting, etc.) associated with the resource. Used for creators, contributors, and other associated entities.
entities.note: Repeatable. Use the type attribute to distinguish personal, corporate, conference, and family names. Use nameTitleGroup to link a name with a related titleInfo.

entities.name: Name Part
entities.description: An individual parsed part that together with other name parts makes up the full name. The type attribute distinguishes date, family, given, and terms of address components.

entities.name: Display Form
entities.description: The form of the name intended for display to the user. Used when the display form differs from the structured name parts, such as when showing a complete name string.

entities.name: Affiliation
entities.description: The name or address of an organization, institution, or other entity with which the named person or corporate body was associated at the time the resource was created.

entities.name: Role
entities.description: Container element designating the relationship (role) of the named entity to the resource. Contains one or more roleTerm sub-elements expressing the role in text or code form.

entities.name: Role Term
entities.description: A textual or coded designation of the relationship (e.g. author, editor, illustrator) of the named entity to the resource. Use authority attribute to indicate the controlled vocabulary (e.g. marcrelator).

entities.name: Name Identifier
entities.description: A unique standard number, code, or URI associated with the named entity. Used for identifiers such as ORCID, ISNI, or VIAF IDs. Introduced in MODS 3.6.
entities.note: Repeatable. Use the type attribute to indicate the identifier scheme (e.g. orcid, isni, viaf).

entities.name: Name Description
entities.description: A textual description of the named entity when additional characterization is necessary to identify the entity. Used when other name sub-elements are insufficient.

entities.name: Alternative Name
entities.description: An alternative name for the same entity described in the parent name element. Introduced in MODS 3.7 to support variant name forms. Contains the same sub-elements as name.
entities.note: Repeatable. Use altType attribute to indicate the type of alternative name (e.g. pseudonym, earlier, later).

entities.name: Type of Resource
entities.description: A term that specifies the general type or category of content of the resource. Uses a controlled vocabulary of broad content types. The collection and manuscript attributes are boolean qualifiers.
entities.note: Repeatable. Values from a controlled list. Use collection='yes' for aggregate resources and manuscript='yes' for handwritten items.

entities.name: Genre
entities.description: A term that designates a category characterizing a particular style, form, or content of the resource. More specific than typeOfResource, genre reflects the intellectual content rather than physical type.
entities.note: Repeatable. Use authority attribute to specify the controlled vocabulary source (e.g. marcgt, lcgft, aat).

entities.name: Origin Info
entities.description: Information about the origin of the resource, including place of origin or publication, publisher/originator, and dates associated with the resource's lifecycle. In MODS 3.8, the agent element generalizes publisher.
entities.note: Repeatable. Use eventType attribute to distinguish publication, production, distribution, manufacture events.

entities.name: Place
entities.description: A place associated with the origin event of the resource. Contains placeTerm sub-elements expressing the place in text or coded form.
entities.note: Repeatable. Use the supplied attribute when the place of publication is inferred rather than stated.

entities.name: Place Term
entities.description: A specific place designation expressed in textual or coded form. The type attribute distinguishes text-based place names from coded forms (e.g. MARC country codes).

entities.name: Agent
entities.description: A generalized element for identifying agents (publishers, manufacturers, distributors, etc.) associated with the origin event. Introduced in MODS 3.8 as a replacement for the publisher element. Contains the same sub-elements as the name element.
entities.note: New in MODS 3.8. Preferred over publisher element for new records. Use type and role sub-elements to specify the agent's relationship.

entities.name: Publisher
entities.description: The name of the entity that published, printed, distributed, released, issued, or produced the resource. Deprecated in MODS 3.8 in favor of the agent element.
entities.note: Deprecated in MODS 3.8. Use agent element for new records.

entities.name: Date Issued
entities.description: The date that the resource was published, released, or issued. For continuing resources, this may include beginning and ending dates.

entities.name: Date Created
entities.description: The date of creation of the resource. Distinct from dateIssued, which refers to publication. Used for the date the intellectual content was created.

entities.name: Date Captured
entities.description: The date on which the resource was digitized or a subsequent snapshot was taken. Used for recording when a digital capture of an analog resource occurred.

entities.name: Date Valid
entities.description: A date in which the content of the resource is valid. Used for resources whose content has a defined period of validity, such as standards, regulations, or datasets.

entities.name: Date Modified
entities.description: The date on which the resource was modified or changed. Refers to modifications of the resource itself rather than the metadata record.

entities.name: Copyright Date
entities.description: A date associated with the copyright of the resource. Distinct from dateIssued which covers publication.

entities.name: Date Other
entities.description: A date associated with the resource that does not fall into another defined date category. The type attribute specifies what kind of date it represents.

entities.name: Edition
entities.description: Information identifying the version or edition of the resource. May include designation such as 'First edition', 'Version 2.0', etc.

entities.name: Issuance
entities.description: A term that designates how the resource is issued or published. Uses a controlled vocabulary: monographic, single unit, multipart monograph, continuing, serial, integrating resource.

entities.name: Frequency
entities.description: The publication frequency of a continuing resource in textual form (e.g. monthly, annual, irregular). Use authority attribute to reference a controlled vocabulary.

entities.name: Language
entities.description: The language of the intellectual content of the resource. Contains languageTerm and/or scriptTerm sub-elements. The objectPart attribute designates which part of the resource uses the specified language.
entities.note: Repeatable. Use separate language elements for multilingual resources.

entities.name: Language Term
entities.description: Contains the language of the resource expressed in textual or coded form. The type attribute distinguishes between text (e.g. 'English') and code (e.g. 'eng'). Use authority to specify the code source.

entities.name: Script Term
entities.description: Contains the script used in the resource expressed in textual or coded form. Uses ISO 15924 script codes. The type attribute distinguishes between text and code forms.

entities.name: Physical Description
entities.description: Information about the physical characteristics of the resource, including form, extent, MIME type, digital origin, and reformatting quality. Contains sub-elements for specific physical attributes.
entities.note: Repeatable. Contains sub-elements only; no direct text content.

entities.name: Form
entities.description: A designation of a particular physical presentation of a resource, including the physical form or medium of material. The type attribute can distinguish material from technique.

entities.name: Reformatting Quality
entities.description: An assessment of the quality of the reformatted version of the resource relative to its intended use. Uses a controlled vocabulary: access, preservation, replacement.
entities.note: Controlled values: access (suitable for viewing), preservation (suitable for long-term retention), replacement (suitable as a substitute for the original).

entities.name: Internet Media Type
entities.description: The electronic format type of the resource expressed as an IANA MIME type (e.g. application/pdf, image/jpeg, text/html).

entities.name: Extent
entities.description: A statement of the physical extent of the resource in terms of units of measurement and material (e.g. '300 pages', '1 sound disc', '45 minutes'). The unit attribute specifies the unit of measurement.

entities.name: Digital Origin
entities.description: The method by which the resource achieved digital form. Uses a controlled vocabulary to distinguish born-digital resources from those digitized from various analog sources.

entities.name: Abstract
entities.description: A summary of the content of the resource. May include a description, annotation, scope and content note, or other form of content summary.
entities.note: Repeatable. Use type attribute to distinguish different kinds of summaries.

entities.name: Table of Contents
entities.description: A description of the contents of the resource, such as a table of contents, list of parts or sections, or other structured listing of contents.
entities.note: Repeatable. Contents may be recorded as unstructured text or as a formatted list.

entities.name: Target Audience
entities.description: A description of the intellectual level, interest level, or special characteristics of the audience for which the resource is intended.
entities.note: Repeatable. Use authority attribute to specify controlled vocabulary source (e.g. marctarget).

entities.name: Note
entities.description: General textual information about the resource that does not fit in other more specific elements. The type attribute categorizes the note.
entities.note: Repeatable. Also used as a sub-element within physicalDescription and location/copyInformation.

entities.name: Subject
entities.description: A term or phrase representing the primary topic(s) of the resource. Contains sub-elements for different types of subject terms including topical, geographic, temporal, name, title, and genre headings.
entities.note: Repeatable. Use authority attribute to specify the subject heading system (e.g. lcsh, mesh, fast).

entities.name: Topic
entities.description: A topical subject term that does not fit into the geographic, temporal, name, title, or other subject categories.

entities.name: Geographic
entities.description: A simple geographic subject term expressed as a single string. For structured hierarchical geographic data, use hierarchicalGeographic instead.

entities.name: Temporal
entities.description: A chronological or temporal subject term used to describe the time period covered or addressed by the resource.

entities.name: Geographic Code
entities.description: A geographic area code used as a subject access point. Typically uses MARC Geographic Area Codes or ISO 3166 country codes.

entities.name: Hierarchical Geographic
entities.description: A geographic name given in a hierarchical form, parsed into individual geographic components from broadest to most specific level.
entities.note: Components appear in hierarchical order. Use authority attribute to reference a geographic thesaurus.

entities.name: Continent
entities.description: The name of a continent in a hierarchical geographic subject heading.

entities.name: Country
entities.description: The name of a country in a hierarchical geographic subject heading.

entities.name: Region
entities.description: The name of a region in a hierarchical geographic subject heading. The regionType attribute can qualify the kind of region.

entities.name: State
entities.description: The name of a state or province in a hierarchical geographic subject heading. The stateType attribute can qualify the kind of administrative unit.

entities.name: Territory
entities.description: The name of a territory in a hierarchical geographic subject heading. Used for political territories that are not states or provinces.

entities.name: County
entities.description: The name of a county or equivalent administrative division in a hierarchical geographic subject heading.

entities.name: City
entities.description: The name of a city or town in a hierarchical geographic subject heading.

entities.name: City Section
entities.description: The name of a section or district of a city in a hierarchical geographic subject heading. The citySectionType attribute qualifies the kind of city section.

entities.name: Island
entities.description: The name of an island in a hierarchical geographic subject heading.

entities.name: Area
entities.description: A general geographic area designation that does not fit another hierarchical geographic category. The areaType attribute qualifies the kind of area.

entities.name: Extraterrestrial Area
entities.description: The name of an extraterrestrial area (e.g. planet, satellite, asteroid) in a hierarchical geographic subject heading.

entities.name: Cartographics
entities.description: Cartographic data such as scale, projection, and coordinates, used to describe the spatial characteristics of the resource.

entities.name: Scale
entities.description: The ratio of distances on a map to actual distances (e.g. '1:24,000').

entities.name: Projection
entities.description: The method of representing the earth's surface on a flat map (e.g. 'Mercator', 'transverse Mercator').

entities.name: Coordinates
entities.description: The geographic coordinates of the area covered by the resource, typically expressed as bounding box coordinates.

entities.name: Occupation
entities.description: An occupation subject term. Used when the content of the resource is about or intended for persons in a specific occupation.

entities.name: Classification
entities.description: A designation applied to a resource that indicates the subject by applying a formal system of coding and organizing resources. The authority attribute identifies the classification scheme (e.g. lcc, ddc, udc).
entities.note: Repeatable. Use separate classification elements for different schemes.

entities.name: Related Item
entities.description: Information that identifies other resources related to the one being described. May contain any MODS top-level element as a sub-element to describe the related resource. The type attribute specifies the nature of the relationship.
entities.note: Repeatable. Can contain a full MODS record describing the related item. Use of type or otherType attribute is strongly recommended.

entities.name: Identifier
entities.description: A unique standard number or code that distinctly identifies the resource. The type attribute specifies the identifier scheme (e.g. doi, isbn, issn, uri, lccn).
entities.note: Repeatable. Use the invalid attribute set to 'yes' for canceled or invalid identifiers.

entities.name: Location
entities.description: Information about the institution or repository holding the resource, the physical location of the resource, and/or the electronic location in the form of a URL.
entities.note: Repeatable. Contains sub-elements for physical and electronic locations as well as holdings data.

entities.name: Physical Location
entities.description: The name of the institution or repository holding the resource, or the physical location of a specific copy. The type attribute can specify current, discovery, former, or creation location.

entities.name: Shelf Locator
entities.description: A shelfmark or other shelving designation indicating the specific location of the resource within a repository.

entities.name: URL
entities.description: The Uniform Resource Location (URL) providing electronic access to the resource. The access attribute specifies whether it is a preview, raw object, or object in context.

fields.name: access
fields.label: Access (preview, raw object, object in context)

entities.name: Holding Simple
entities.description: A container for summary holdings information about a copy of the resource held at a specific location. Contains copyInformation sub-elements.

entities.name: Copy Information
entities.description: Information about a specific copy of the resource, including its form, sub-location, shelf locator, electronic locator, notes, enumeration, and identifiers.

entities.name: Enumeration and Chronology
entities.description: Identification of the parts of a multipart resource held at the location. Uses unitType to distinguish basic bibliographic unit (1), supplementary material (2), and indexes (3).

entities.name: Item Identifier
entities.description: A unique standard number or code identifying a specific copy of the resource. The type attribute specifies the identifier scheme.

entities.name: Holding External
entities.description: A container for holdings information using an externally defined schema such as ISO 20775 (Holdings Schema). Allows embedding non-MODS holdings data.
entities.note: Contains XML from external schemas. Use when holdingSimple is insufficient for complex holdings data.

entities.name: Access Condition
entities.description: Information about restrictions imposed on access to or use of the resource. The type attribute distinguishes between restriction on access and use and reproduction terms.
entities.note: Repeatable. There is no controlled list of types, but suggested values include 'restriction on access' and 'use and reproduction'.

fields.name: accessConditionType
fields.label: Type (restriction on access, use and reproduction)

entities.name: Part
entities.description: Information about a physical or logical part of the resource, such as a volume, issue, or chapter. Used to describe enumeration and pagination of component parts.
entities.note: Repeatable. Use type attribute to categorize the part and order attribute for sequencing.

entities.name: Detail
entities.description: Detailed enumeration information about a part, including number, caption, and title. The type attribute specifies the kind of detail (e.g. volume, issue, chapter, page).

entities.name: Part Extent
entities.description: The extent of a part expressed as a range with start and end values, a total count, or a textual list. Distinct from the physicalDescription extent element.
entities.note: The unit attribute specifies the unit of measurement (e.g. pages, minutes).

entities.name: Part Date
entities.description: A date associated with a specific part of the resource. Uses the same date attributes as other MODS date elements.

entities.name: Text
entities.description: A textual designation of a part of the resource that cannot be adequately expressed using the detail or extent sub-elements.

entities.name: Extension
entities.description: A wrapper element for additional metadata not covered by the MODS schema. Used to embed metadata from other schemas or local extensions without violating MODS validity.
entities.note: Repeatable. Content may be from any namespace. Used to extend MODS with local or community-specific metadata.

entities.name: Record Info
entities.description: Information about the metadata record itself rather than the resource being described. Includes data about the record's creation, modification, origin, content source, and cataloging standards used.
entities.note: Contains sub-elements only. Use displayLabel and altRepGroup attributes as needed.

entities.name: Record Content Source
entities.description: The code or name of the organization or entity that created or modified the original metadata record. Use authority to specify the code source (e.g. marcorg).

entities.name: Record Creation Date
entities.description: The date or date and time when the original metadata record was first created.

entities.name: Record Change Date
entities.description: The date or date and time when the original metadata record was last modified.

entities.name: Record Identifier
entities.description: The system control number assigned by the organization creating, using, or distributing the record. The source attribute identifies the assigning organization.

entities.name: Record Origin
entities.description: A description of the origin or provenance of the metadata record, such as how it was created (e.g. machine-generated, converted from MARC, hand-created).

entities.name: Record Info Note
entities.description: General textual information relating to the metadata record itself, such as notes about its creation, conversion, or quality.

entities.name: Language of Cataloging
entities.description: The language used in creating the metadata record. Contains languageTerm and scriptTerm sub-elements to express the cataloging language in text or code form.

entities.name: Description Standard
entities.description: The descriptive cataloging rules or conventions used for the content of the description (e.g. AACR2, RDA, DACS, ISBD).

typeOfResourceValues.text: Text resources including books, articles, and documents
typeOfResourceValues.cartographic: Maps, atlases, globes, and related cartographic materials
typeOfResourceValues.sound recording-nonmusical: Non-musical audio recordings such as speeches and interviews
typeOfResourceValues.still image: Photographs, prints, drawings, and other static visual representations
typeOfResourceValues.three dimensional object: Physical objects, models, sculptures, and artifacts

titleTypes.uniform: Standardized or authorized form of the title

nameTypes.corporate: Name of an organization, institution, or corporation
nameTypes.conference: Name of a conference, meeting, or event
nameTypes.family: Name of a family or dynasty

namePartTypes.date: Date associated with the name (e.g. birth/death dates)
namePartTypes.termsOfAddress: Titles, honorifics, or other terms of address

issuanceValues.multipart monograph: Multipart item issued in a finite number of parts
issuanceValues.continuing: Ongoing resource with no predetermined conclusion
issuanceValues.serial: Publication issued in successive parts at regular or irregular intervals
issuanceValues.integrating resource: Resource updated by additions or changes integrated into the whole

relatedItemTypes.preceding: Earlier version or predecessor of the resource
relatedItemTypes.succeeding: Later version or successor of the resource
relatedItemTypes.original: Original version from which the resource derives
relatedItemTypes.host: Larger resource that contains the described resource
relatedItemTypes.constituent: Part contained within the described resource
relatedItemTypes.series: Series to which the resource belongs
relatedItemTypes.otherVersion: Another version of the same resource
relatedItemTypes.otherFormat: Same content in a different physical format
relatedItemTypes.isReferencedBy: Resource that references the described resource
relatedItemTypes.references: Resource referenced by the described resource
relatedItemTypes.reviewOf: Resource reviewed by the described resource

digitalOriginValues.born digital: Resource created originally in digital form
digitalOriginValues.reformatted digital: Resource digitized from an analog original
digitalOriginValues.digitized other analog: Resource digitized from another analog source

reformattingQualityValues.access: Quality suitable for access and viewing
reformattingQualityValues.replacement: Quality sufficient to serve as a substitute for the original

dateEncodings.w3cdtf: W3C Date and Time Format (subset of ISO 8601)

dateQualifiers.inferred: Date is inferred from other evidence

accessConditionTypes.restriction on access: Restrictions imposed on access to the described materials
accessConditionTypes.use and reproduction: Terms governing the use and reproduction of the materials after access

placeTermTypes.code: Place expressed as a code (e.g. MARC country code)
